name: Kraken
dataSource: Monster statistics: OSRS Wiki via bundled monsters.json. Strategies: attack styles that can damage the boss (generated by scripts/gen-bosses.mjs).
validationNotes: Single-phase fight with no unmodelled damage rules; DPS is covered by the reference validation tests. Strategies are the attack styles that can damage this boss, best-known first; they are not a strategy guide. Damage-taken weights for Survivability are derived from the attack styles listed for the boss, equally weighted.

requirements.text: Requires an active cave kraken slayer task

warnings: The Kraken cannot be damaged with melee and ranged damage against it is divided by 7, so only a magic strategy is offered.

strategies.name: Magic
strategies.description: Magic setup for the whole fight.
